tips.text: Land Inner Flame on the enemy champion, not just minions. Hitting champions with your damaging abilities and basic attacks brings Mantra back sooner.
Inner Flame stops at the first unit it hits, so aim it where no minion stands between you and the enemy.
Use Focused Resolve on an enemy champion and keep within range so the tether holds. If it stays unbroken, they take damage again and are rooted.
Cast Mantra before Focused Resolve when you want a longer root. It also heals you.
Shield your carry with Inspire when the enemy is about to trade on them. The Move Speed also helps them step out of danger.
Cast Mantra before Inspire when your team is grouped. Allies near your target also get a shield and Move Speed.
Cast Mantra before Inner Flame to leave a fire circle that slows enemies inside and then hurts them. Use it to zone them or finish a chase.
Keep your distance from Alistar and poke with Inner Flame. His engage needs to reach you first.
Put Focused Resolve on Alistar as he charges; if he stays tethered he is rooted and cannot follow up.
Slow Alistar with Inner Flame when he walks up. He will have a hard time reaching you.
Stay away from walls and turrets with Alistar near; Headbutt can knock you into trouble before Pulverize lands.
Hold Mantra for a Soulflare when Alistar is stuck in a fight; the lingering circle slows and then bursts.
Back off when Alistar uses Unbreakable Will; hitting him then does little.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line; it keeps going through minions, so minions will not shield you.
Use Inner Flame on Anivia to make her slowed, then back off before she follows with Frostbite.
Use Focused Resolve on Anivia when she is out of position; she is rooted if she stays tethered.
Put Inspire on yourself or your ally before Flash Frost lands; the shield absorbs Frostbite and the burst.
Do not fully commit to killing Anivia early. Rebirth brings her back with full health if the egg survives.
Hit Bard with Inner Flame when he walks up for chimes or last-hits; each hit on a champion cuts Mantra's cooldown.
Stay out of a straight line with your own ally or a wall when Bard is aiming; his Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second enemy or terrain.
Use Focused Resolve on Bard when he steps forward, then keep him in range so the tether holds and he is rooted.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Bard's bolt is coming; it also speeds them up to dodge the follow-up.
If Bard opens a Magical Journey portal, you can follow him through it when it is safe, so don't panic when he vanishes.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits them first; it only pulls the first enemy it touches.
Slow him with Inner Flame when he walks up, so he can't easily close the distance for a grab.
Use Focused Resolve on him and walk away from the tether to root him. Blitzcrank has no escape except Overdrive.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Blitzcrank's Static Field is ready; Static Field destroys shields when he uses it.
Inspire gives Move Speed; cast it on yourself or your ally when you see Blitzcrank's hand, then dodge sideways.
Hit Brand with Inner Flame whenever he steps up to poke; it slows him and trims the cooldown on Mantra.
Put Inspire on your ally when Brand's Sear is coming; the shield and speed help you dodge the stun that follows.
Keep your allies spread out. Brand's Conflagration spreads further from a burning target, so a bunched group takes more damage.
Use Focused Resolve on Brand when he commits to a combo. If he stays in range, he is rooted and you can hit him.
Cast Mantra before Inspire in a team fight; the shield then covers your nearby allies too, which helps against Pyroclasm.
Aim Inner Flame down the line before Braum raises Unbreakable; his shield destroys it when he faces you, so wait until it drops.
Inner Flame stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of Braum soaks it. Line up a clear shot.
Stay out of Braum's reach when you walk up. Do not let him land a basic attack or Winter's Bite, or his team can stack a stun on you.
Use Focused Resolve on Braum when he steps forward to engage; the root holds him in place. Keep your distance so the tether is not broken.
Put Inspire on your carry when Braum threatens to dive. The shield and speed help them escape his slow.
Dodge Glacial Fissure by moving sideways during its long cast, and do not cross the ice it leaves behind.
Hit Camille with Inner Flame when she walks up; it slows her and each hit on a champion shortens the wait for Mantra.
Use Focused Resolve on Camille when she dives in. If she stays in range, she is rooted and easy to hit.
Put Inspire on your ally before Camille dives. The shield and Move Speed help them survive her stun and trade.
Save Mantra with Inspire for when Camille dives onto a group. It shields nearby allies as well.
Stay away from walls. Camille needs terrain for Hookshot, so standing out in open lane makes her dive harder.
Land Inner Flame on Janna and her partner; each champion hit lowers the cooldown of Mantra.
Use Focused Resolve on Janna and walk after her; if the tether holds, she is rooted and cannot use Zephyr or flee.
Stay out of a charging Howling Gale's path; it knocks you up, so listen for the charge sound.
Hold your attack while Janna channels Monsoon only if you can interrupt her; otherwise back off, since she heals her allies.
Keep your distance from Leona and poke with Inner Flame; its bolt stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim it at her rather than a minion in the way.
Slow Leona with Inner Flame when she dashes in, so you can walk away from her follow-up.
Tether Leona with Focused Resolve when she closes in and then step away. If the tether holds, she is rooted.
Shield yourself or your carry with Inspire just before Leona engages. Its move speed helps you get out of her reach.
Land your abilities on Leona's team to bring Mantra back sooner, then use it for a bigger slow or a stronger shield.
Move out of the center of Solar Flare when you see it land. Only the middle stuns, and the rest of it only slows.
Land Inner Flame on Lulu and her partner to slow them and lower Mantra's cooldown. Hit her whenever she steps up to use Glitterlance.
Stand behind your minions. Inner Flame stops at the first unit it hits, so line up a clear path before you fire.
Use Focused Resolve on Lulu from long range and keep the tether unbroken. She has to stay in range or take the second hit and be rooted.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Lulu's Pix harass or Glitterlance is about to land. Use Mantra first when you need to cover your whole team in a fight.
Stay out of Whimsy range when you can, or keep Inspire ready to speed an ally away. Do not walk up carelessly while it is available.
Use Focused Resolve on Lux and keep your distance from her so the tether holds. She is easier to catch when rooted.
Stay out of a straight line with Lux and stand behind minions. Light Binding only roots the first two enemies it hits.
Hit Lux with Inner Flame when she walks up to trade. Each hit shortens the wait for Mantra.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Lux is about to throw Lucent Singularity or Light Binding, and use the speed to leave the area.
Step out of Lucent Singularity before it blows up. Leave the circle quickly, because it slows anyone inside.
Hit Maokai with Inner Flame from long range; it slows him and each hit shortens the wait for Mantra.
Don't waste spells on Maokai when he is hurt; every spell that hits him speeds up his self-heal. Aim at his partner when you can.
Step out of Twisted Advance range, or save Inspire to speed up and break away, because it roots on arrival.
Keep away from bushes where Maokai may have tossed a Sapling. Those hit much harder and last longer.
Use Focused Resolve on Maokai when he walks up. Keep your distance for the root to land.
Hold Inner Flame until Mel has used Rebuttal; the nova destroys projectiles that touch it, so a blast thrown into it is wasted.
Stay out of the line of Solar Snare. Karma is easy to catch with it, and the longer it travels, the longer the root lasts.
Tether Mel with Focused Resolve when she is out of position. Walk out of her reach and she gets rooted, so you can follow up.
Back off when her Overwhelm marker shows on your health bar and your health is low; one more hit can kill you.
Land a hit on Mel to shorten Mantra's cooldown. Then use Mantra on Inner Flame to slow her with a lingering circle.
Hit Milio with Inner Flame when he walks up; it slows him, and each hit shortens Mantra's cooldown with Gathering Fire.
Tether Milio with Focused Resolve when he is far from his allies, then walk after him so the tether holds and he gets rooted.
Aim Inner Flame carefully into the lane; it stops on the first unit it hits, so a minion in front will soak it.
Shield yourself or your carry with Inspire right before Milio's kick lands; it gives a shield and speed to walk out of the explosion.
Use Mantra with Focused Resolve to root Milio for longer when you commit to a kill.
Stay behind minions so Dark Binding hits them first; it stops at the first enemy it touches.
Use Inspire on yourself or your carry when Morgana is ready to throw Dark Binding; the shield does not stop the root, so dodge it.
Do not waste Focused Resolve while Black Shield is up; it blocks the root. Wait until the shield is gone.
Step out of Tormented Shadow quickly, especially when low on Health, since it hurts more then.
Poke with Inner Flame at range; it slows Morgana and the hits shorten your Mantra wait.
Aim Inner Flame at the enemy champion, not a minion in front; it bursts on the first unit it hits. Hitting champions also shortens Mantra's cooldown.
Use Focused Resolve when Nami has just thrown her bubble. Staying tethered roots her, so she can't dodge your follow-up.
Aqua Prison lands slowly after she throws it. Walk sideways as soon as she casts and keep Inspire ready to speed up your carry.
Trade with Inner Flame when her Tidecaller's Blessing is spent or on cooldown. Her empowered attacks slow and hurt.
Step out of the wave from Tidal Wave early; it travels slowly. Use Inspire to shield your team if it lands.
Stay out of Dredge Line range and behind your minions; Inner Flame stops at the first unit it hits, so you can still poke from safety.
Tether Nautilus with Focused Resolve and walk away so the tether holds. He is rooted and cannot close the gap.
Hit Nautilus with Inner Flame to cut Mantra's cooldown, and slow him as he walks up.
Hold Inspire for your carry when Nautilus is near. The shield and speed help them survive and get away.
Hit Neeko with Inner Flame when she walks up to trade; the slow makes it harder for her to land Tangle-Barbs or reach you.
Stay out of line with Neeko's Tangle-Barbs and keep minions out of its path, because it grows stronger after hitting something.
Use Focused Resolve on Neeko when she is at the edge of her range, then stay on the tether to root her.
Shield your ally with Inspire before Neeko's Pop Blossom lands; it cannot stop the knock up, but it soaks some of the damage.
Do not trust a lone minion or ally that stands oddly near you. Neeko can be disguised, so hit it with Focused Resolve to reveal her.
Use Focused Resolve when Pantheon jumps on you or your carry; if the tether holds, he is rooted. Keep out of his reach so he cannot break it.
Poke with Inner Flame when Pantheon walks up to last-hit; it slows him and each hit shortens the wait for Mantra.
Put Inspire on your carry before Pantheon can jump in. The shield and the speed boost make his stun-and-burst trade much weaker.
Save Mantra for when you need it in a fight. Empowered Inspire shields the allies near your target too.
Poke with Inner Flame from long range; Poppy has to walk up to you, and each hit on her shortens the wait for Mantra.
Stay out of her reach and watch her Heroic Charge. If it carries you or your carry into a wall, you get stunned.
Put Inspire on an ally Poppy targets. The shield absorbs her damage and the speed helps them get away.
Use Focused Resolve on Poppy when she commits to a fight. Your tether roots her if she can't break it.
Don't rely on dashes or knockbacks near Poppy while Steadfast Presence is up, because it stops dashes.
Move away when you see Poppy spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict. It sends you flying toward your Nexus, so keep your distance.
Hit Pyke with Inner Flame when he walks up to hook; it slows him and each hit shortens the wait for Mantra.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Pyke is about to hook; it also speeds them up so they can get away.
Use Focused Resolve on Pyke when he dives in. He is revealed, and if he stays in range he is rooted.
Keep your low-health allies away from Pyke, since Death From Below executes them. Shield them with Inspire.
Chase Pyke after a trade and deny his healing. Gift of the Drowned Ones only heals him when you can't see him.
Hit Rakan with Inner Flame from range; it slows him and every hit shortens the wait for Mantra.
Tether Rakan with Focused Resolve when he is far from his partner; stay in range and he gets rooted.
Stay out of Grand Entrance range and spread from your lane partner; it knocks up everyone close to where Rakan lands.
Rakan's dash shows where he is going. Aim Inner Flame at the spot he lands.
Put Inspire on your partner when Rakan's team threatens to engage; the shield and speed help you escape.
Keep Inner Flame and Focused Resolve ready for when Rell dismounts. Poke her from range so she can't get close.
Put Inspire on yourself or your ally before Rell's Shattering Strike lands; it destroys shields, so a shield cast early is wasted.
Use Focused Resolve on Rell when she charges in. If she stays tethered she is rooted, so she can't reach you.
Slow Rell with Inner Flame when she runs at you; she then has a harder time closing the gap.
Mantra on Inner Flame at level 6 makes a slowing field that punishes Rell for walking in. Use it when the enemy bunches up.
Hit Senna with Inner Flame when she walks up to attack; she has to stand close to trade, so poke her and slow her.
Tether Senna with Focused Resolve when she steps forward, then keep her in range so she ends up rooted.
Keep Mantra ready. Land Inner Flame or Focused Resolve on Senna to bring it back sooner.
Stay out of a line with Senna and her teammates. Last Embrace stops at the first enemy it hits, so stand behind a minion.
Use Inspire on yourself or your carry when Senna's Last Embrace is coming. The shield and speed help you get out of the root.
Land Inner Flame on Seraphine to slow her, then follow with Focused Resolve so she cannot walk out of the tether.
Hit Seraphine with abilities often; each hit on a champion shortens the wait for Mantra.
Stay out of a line with Seraphine's Beat Drop; if you are already slowed it roots you, so avoid being slowed first.
Shield your carry with Inspire when Seraphine's Encore charm is coming; the shield and speed help you survive the follow-up.
Empower Inner Flame with Mantra to zone Seraphine; the fire circle slows anyone who stays in it.
Poke Shen with Inner Flame from long range; the first target hit takes the blast and is slowed, so he has trouble closing the gap.
Stay out of Shadow Dash range. If he misses, hit him with Inner Flame and Focused Resolve while he is out of position.
Use Focused Resolve when Shen dives in, then back away so the tether holds and he is rooted.
Put Inspire on your carry when Shen threatens a dive. The shield and speed help them get away.
Keep hitting Shen with abilities to bring Mantra back faster, then use it on Inner Flame for a big area hit.
Land Inner Flame on Sona; she has little health early, and the slow keeps her from backing away.
Tether Sona with Focused Resolve and stay close so the root lands. She is fragile, so you can follow up with a kill.
Stay out of Sona's range of Hymn of Valor when you can, so she can't build Accelerando cheaply off you.
Spread out from your partner so Crescendo cannot stun you both at once. Back off if Sona's ultimate is ready.
Use Inspire on your carry before a trade to shield them and speed them up.
Dodge Starcall, as every hit slows you and heals Soraka. Stay out of its range when she is aiming.
Wait for Equinox to be used, then poke her back. Its cooldown is long, and she cannot easily zone you afterwards.
Use Focused Resolve on Soraka and stick to her. Her lane partner cannot easily help once she is rooted.
Hit her with Inner Flame to bring Mantra back sooner. Land it on Soraka rather than on minions.
Cast Inspire on your carry to shield them and speed them up when Soraka's Equinox is coming.
Aim Inner Flame at the first target in its path; it stops on the first unit it hits, so a minion in the way soaks it.
Use Inner Flame to poke Swain from long range, since his Death's Hand has a shorter reach than your spell.
Hitting Swain with your damaging abilities lowers Mantra's cooldown, so keep trading when he steps up.
Put Inspire on your carry just before Swain's Nevermove returns; the shield and speed help them break free after the root.
Use Mantra with Focused Resolve to root Swain longer when he dives in; step away from him so the tether holds.
When Swain turns into his demon, run away and slow him with Inner Flame instead of fighting inside his range.
Poke Tahm Kench with Inner Flame from long range; it slows him, and every hit on a champion shortens Mantra's cooldown.
Stay out of range when his Tongue Lash is ready. A stunned Karma gets devoured or pulled into the enemy team.
Watch for Abyssal Dive. He channels for a while before landing, so step away from the marked spot instead of staying in it.
Hit Tahm Kench with Focused Resolve while he is channeling Abyssal Dive. Rooting him stops the dive.
Hold Inspire for yourself or your carry when his Tongue Lash comes. It gives a shield and speed to get out of range.
Don't waste long fights trading into his Thick Skin. Poke him when he has just taken damage and can't heal it back.
Hit Taric with Inner Flame when he walks up to the minions; he is slowed and you shorten Mantra's wait.
Stay out of Dazzle's line and keep moving after Taric starts the wind-up; it bursts a moment later, so you can step aside.
Use Focused Resolve on Taric only when he cannot easily step out of range. Staying tethered is what roots him.
Use Mantra before Inner Flame to leave a fire circle that slows him. It punishes Taric when he lingers in the minion wave.
Hit the enemy with Inner Flame whenever you can; each champion it hits shortens the wait for Mantra, and the slow helps you keep your distance.
Stand behind your minions. Death Sentence stops at the first unit it hits, so a minion in front of you can catch the hook.
Watch Thresh's cast animation start, then step sideways. Death Sentence takes time to cast, so dodge as soon as you see it begin.
Use Inspire on yourself or your carry when Thresh looks ready to engage. The shield and speed boost help you break away from a pull or a Flay.
Root Thresh with Focused Resolve when he comes in to hook. Make sure you stay in range so the tether stays unbroken.
Save Mantra for Focused Resolve when you are fighting Thresh, since it roots longer and heals you.
Hit Vel'Koz with Inner Flame to slow him; he has little mobility, so follow up with Focused Resolve while he is stuck in range.
Stay behind your minions when Vel'Koz aims Plasma Fission. The bolt keeps going after a hit and splits, so it can still reach you.
Save Inspire for when Vel'Koz casts Tectonic Disruption. It shields you and speeds you up to escape.
Use Mantra with Focused Resolve to root Vel'Koz for longer when he is in a good spot to be caught.
Close the gap on Xerath and trade; he is weak up close and his long range does little once you are on him.
Use Focused Resolve on Xerath when he is out of position; if he stays tethered he is rooted and easy to follow up on.
Fire Inner Flame at Xerath when he stands behind minions? It stops at the first unit, so line it up on him with no minion in front.
Keep Inspire ready for your carry; the shield and speed help them dodge Shocking Orb and Eye of Destruction.
Hit Xerath with abilities to bring Mantra back sooner, then use it on Inner Flame for a big burst.
Aim Inner Flame at Yuumi when she is detached; she can't be targeted while attached, so wait for her to hop off before you poke.
Hit Yuumi with Focused Resolve while she is off her partner. It tethers her, reveals her, and roots her if she can't break away.
Inner Flame stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim at the ADC when Yuumi stands behind. Anyone near the blast is hurt and slowed.
Use Mantra before Inner Flame when both enemies are close together. The flame circle punishes anyone who stays in it.
Stay out of Time Bomb's small circle, and walk away from a bomb that sticks to you. Do not stand next to your ally when a second bomb is thrown.
Hit Zilean with Inner Flame when he walks up to the minions. It slows him and shortens the wait for Mantra.
Use Focused Resolve with Mantra on Zilean. He is slow to kill, so the longer root gives you time to hit him.
Zilean's Chronoshift can bring his carry back, so hold your last hit until it ends.
Hit Zyra with Inner Flame from long range; the blast slows her and each hit shortens Mantra's cooldown.
Stay out of Zyra's Grasping Roots line, and keep Inspire ready to speed yourself or your carry away if it lands.
Zyra is fragile. Tether her with Focused Resolve and make her stay still, or she breaks the tether and the root fails.
Walk over Zyra's seeds before she can grow plants from them. Fight away from her seeds.
Use Mantra with Inner Flame when Zyra stands still to plant or cast; the circle of flame punishes her for staying there.
